2026-08-07
RTI's French Service Returns to Shortwave for August 2026
Radio Taiwan International's French Service is running special direct shortwave broadcasts from Taiwan every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday through August 30, 2026, aimed at listeners in Europe and North Africa.
